methodology: Listings describe external platforms offering tasks, services, studies, field work, offers, or digital products. Reward and availability are indicative and must be verified on the official source.

opportunities.title: Paid research studies
opportunities.description: Take academic and product research studies matched to your profile.
opportunities.reward: Usually a few dollars per study
opportunities.requirements: Account approval and an honest demographic profile.

opportunities.title: Join paid interviews and studies
opportunities.description: Apply for research interviews and product studies looking for specific roles or experiences.
opportunities.requirements: Accurate profile and eligibility for each study.

opportunities.title: Participate in mobile research missions
opportunities.description: Share diary entries, videos, photos, and feedback in selected research missions.
opportunities.effort: Days to weeks in short sessions
opportunities.requirements: Mobile device, detailed applications, and mission completion.

opportunities.title: Answer opinion surveys
opportunities.description: Share opinions in recurring surveys and build points toward available rewards.
opportunities.reward: Points and rewards vary by country
opportunities.requirements: Verified account and a consistent profile.

opportunities.title: Complete short mobile surveys
opportunities.description: Choose short surveys in a mobile app and receive the reward shown before starting.
opportunities.requirements: Mobile app, screening answers, and supported payout method.

opportunities.title: Test websites and apps
opportunities.description: Record your screen and voice while completing tasks on websites and apps.
opportunities.requirements: Microphone, compatible device, and passing sample test.

opportunities.title: Give feedback on digital products
opportunities.description: Complete usability tests and share written or recorded feedback on websites and apps.
opportunities.requirements: Device, clear feedback, and accepted test submission.

opportunities.title: Review designs and prototypes
opportunities.description: Answer short questions about designs, interfaces, and user experience decisions.
opportunities.requirements: Fast, thoughtful answers and supported payout method.

opportunities.title: Find bugs in websites and apps
opportunities.description: Join software testing projects and report reproducible bugs for review.
opportunities.requirements: Tester account, supported devices, and ability to write clear bug reports.

opportunities.title: Test software releases
opportunities.description: Participate in software testing cycles and report defects or test results.
opportunities.requirements: Profile, testing skills, and compatible devices.

opportunities.title: Playtest mobile games
opportunities.description: Play unreleased games and record feedback about the experience.
opportunities.reward: Usually a small reward per accepted playtest
opportunities.requirements: Compatible mobile device, microphone, and spoken feedback.

opportunities.title: Crowdtest digital products
opportunities.description: Test websites, apps, and connected products in crowdtesting projects.
opportunities.requirements: Registered tester profile and clear evidence for issues.

opportunities.title: Microtasks and data work
opportunities.description: Complete categorization, text, research, photo, and data-verification tasks.
opportunities.requirements: Verified account; some projects require assessments.

opportunities.title: Online data-labeling tasks
opportunities.description: Help evaluate search, content, images, and AI data through short tasks.
opportunities.requirements: Identity and payment verification may be required.

opportunities.title: Human Intelligence Tasks (HITs)
opportunities.description: Complete short data, research, transcription, and moderation tasks posted by requesters.
opportunities.reward: Often cents to a few dollars per HIT
opportunities.requirements: Worker account, tax information, and requester qualifications.

opportunities.title: Language and AI data tasks
opportunities.description: Apply for language, audio, image, and text data projects used to improve AI systems.
opportunities.requirements: Verified profile and completion of any project qualification.

opportunities.title: Remote language and data projects
opportunities.description: Find transcription, translation, data collection, and AI evaluation projects.
opportunities.requirements: Profile, screening, and sometimes identity verification.

opportunities.title: AI training and evaluation projects
opportunities.description: Apply for remote data-collection, transcription, evaluation, and AI-training projects.
opportunities.requirements: Application, screening, and sometimes specialist skills.

opportunities.title: Evaluate and improve AI responses
opportunities.description: Apply for projects that involve writing, evaluating, or improving AI-generated responses.
opportunities.requirements: Strong language or subject skills and successful onboarding.

opportunities.title: Write and review AI responses
opportunities.description: Apply for flexible remote work evaluating, comparing, or writing responses for AI systems.
opportunities.requirements: Strong writing or subject expertise and platform assessment.

opportunities.title: Search and content evaluation
opportunities.description: Apply for search relevance, ads quality, speech, and data-collection projects.
opportunities.requirements: Application, assessments, and identity verification may apply.

opportunities.title: Sell a small digital service
opportunities.description: Offer a focused service such as translation, thumbnails, data cleanup, voiceover, or short writing.
opportunities.requirements: Clear gig, samples, delivery time, and account verification.

opportunities.title: Apply to small freelance projects
opportunities.description: Find short contracts for admin support, design, writing, coding, research, and translation.
opportunities.requirements: Profile, portfolio, proposal, and platform eligibility.

opportunities.title: Compete for small freelance jobs
opportunities.description: Browse projects and contests for design, writing, data entry, marketing, and development.
opportunities.availability: Global; bid and contest rules apply
opportunities.requirements: Profile, proposal or submission, and current platform rules.

opportunities.title: Sell a small digital product
opportunities.description: Publish templates, guides, presets, spreadsheets, or other original digital downloads.
opportunities.reward: You set the price; sales dependent
opportunities.requirements: Original product, clear license, and an audience or distribution plan.

opportunities.title: Complete local information tasks
opportunities.description: Use a phone to complete available local surveys, observations, and information-gathering tasks.
opportunities.availability: Country, location, and task supply dependent
opportunities.requirements: Smartphone, location permissions, and accurate submissions.

opportunities.title: Complete local store checks
opportunities.description: Visit stores or locations to answer questions, take photos, or verify product information.
opportunities.availability: Supported locations and task availability dependent
opportunities.requirements: Smartphone, ability to travel locally, and evidence requirements.

opportunities.title: Do nearby retail audits
opportunities.description: Find nearby assignments involving retail checks, photos, and product information.
opportunities.requirements: Mobile device, location access, and accurate proof of completion.

opportunities.title: Complete online offers and surveys
opportunities.description: Browse available surveys, app trials, and offerwall tasks and review the terms before opting in.
opportunities.requirements: Read the advertiser conditions; never buy something solely to chase a reward.

opportunities.title: Surveys and offerwall tasks
opportunities.description: Complete available surveys and online offers in the regions and categories shown to your account.
opportunities.requirements: Check completion rules and payout conditions before starting.
